en.headline: Retail sales rise 4.5 per cent in July, extending streak to 15 months
en.dek: Provisional Census and Statistics Department figures put July sales at HK$31 billion; jewellery and watches led the gain while motor vehicles and fuel fell.
body: The value of retail sales in July rose 4.5 per cent from a year earlier to a provisional HK$31 billion, the Census and Statistics Department said, marking a 15th consecutive month of expansion. Sales in the first seven months of 2026 were 8.9 per cent higher than in the same period of 2025.

Jewellery, watches and clocks, and valuable gifts recorded the strongest increase, up 19.7 per cent year on year. Electrical goods and other consumer durables rose 11.5 per cent, unclassified consumer goods 10.5 per cent and medicines and cosmetics 7.3 per cent. Sales of motor vehicles and parts fell 18.2 per cent and fuel 18 per cent.

Online retail sales reached HK$2.8 billion, up 9.5 per cent, and accounted for 9.1 per cent of the total. A government spokesman said growth momentum remained resilient and that continued economic expansion, higher household incomes, a stable labour market and upcoming mega-events should support sentiment, while external risks would be watched.

Hong Kong Retail Management Association chairwoman Annie Yau Tse said July was weaker than hoped, citing frequent rainstorm and typhoon signals that deterred incoming visitors and summer outbound travel by local residents.

zh.headline: 7月零售銷貨價值升4.5% 連續第15個月增長
zh.dek: 政府統計處臨時數字顯示7月零售銷貨約310億元；珠寶鐘錶升幅最大，汽車及燃料則下跌。
body: 政府統計處公布，7月零售業總銷貨價值臨時估計為310億元，按年升4.5%，連續第15個月錄得增長。今年首七個月銷貨價值較2025年同期升8.9%。
按類別計，珠寶首飾、鐘錶及名貴禮物升幅最大，按年升19.7%；電器及其他未分類耐用消費品升11.5%；其他未分類消費品升10.5%；藥物及化妝品升7.3%。汽車及汽車零件跌18.2%，燃料跌18%。
網上零售銷貨達28億元，按年升9.5%，佔整體9.1%。政府發言人表示，增長動力保持強韌，經濟持續擴張、住戶收入上升及勞工市場穩定有助消費氛圍，未來盛事亦望帶動訪港旅客，但外部不利因素仍在演變。
香港零售管理協會主席謝邱安儀表示，7月表現未如理想，指當月頻密暴雨及颱風警告影響內地旅客訪港，而暑假亦有較多港人外遊。
